caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden mantle clock with a dark reddish-brown finish. The clock has an octagonal face surrounded by a frame of the same wood color. The clock face is white with black Roman numerals from I to XII, and contains several gold elements in the center, possibly representing the clock's inner mechanisms. There are two black clock hands, indicating the time, along with a visible brass knob to the left of the clock face. Below the face, there is a rectangular panel with a decorative grid pattern in yellow and black. The clock sits on a rectangular base of the same wood tone. The background is plain and beige, and the name "McCollum" is written at the bottom right corner.
title: Seth Thomas Clock (?)
